title: What a diagram is for: communicating, not decorating

videos.script: Every architecture has a diagram, and most of those diagrams answer nothing. {{title}} You know the one. Twelve logos, a cloud, some arrows, no words on any of them. It looked finished in the meeting. A week later nobody can say what the arrows meant. {{decorated}} This course follows one company, Carcará. It sells bus tickets across Bahia, and it has forty engineers and a lot of diagrams. {{carcara}} A diagram is a tool for one question and one reader. Who calls whom. Where the data lives. What happens when the payment fails. {{answered}} This lesson is about that question. What a box claims, what a line claims, and why an arrow with no label claims five things at once. {{arrow}} It ends with the views an architecture needs, because no single picture can hold all of them. {{views}} You need nothing installed for this. Paper works.
